items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 69:1
items.html: (To the question) ZON, which rise as MAN to Aba and Ima, at the time that they feel the lack of the illumination of Hochma, through the raising of the MAN of the souls of the righteous to them, cause also in the upper Ima the need for the illumination of Hochma, in order to bestow to ZON, by virtue of their being her children, namely, by virtue of the connection that Bina has with ZON, from the secret of the ten Sefirot of the direct light, where Bina bestows there the illumination of Hochma to ZON. And therefore also Aba and Ima rise to the GAR of AA and are included in the coupling of AA, palate and throat, in the secret of the Mazalot, as above in Answer 212. (Items 103 and 104).
